init.title: Idratek Cortex options

data_description.button_interval: 0 turns button polling off, so presses only arrive by push from Cortex. Otherwise presses last a few seconds, so use 1 to 3 seconds.

init.description:
Push address for Cortex (Web API Client): {webhook_url}

Send three parameters: object (the Cortex object id), port (the output port name) and value (the Cortex tag for that port). See the README for an example.
